# Time Tracking Template
## SocialEngage

**Purpose:** Track time spent on project activities to enable estimation accuracy metrics and capacity planning.

**Approach:** Lightweight, manual tracking using a simple table format. Each entry represents a focused work session.

---

## 📊 Time Tracking Log

**Format:** One row per session. Use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

| Date | Start Time | End Time | Duration (min) | Activity | Story/ADR | Notes |
|------|------------|----------|----------------|----------|-----------|-------|
| 2026-08-01 | 09:00 | 10:30 | 90 | Implement Story 2.7 | Story 2.7 / ADR-0026 | GNews connector |
| 2026-08-01 | 13:00 | 14:15 | 75 | Debug test failures | Story 2.7 | Contract edge cases |
| 2026-08-01 | 15:00 | 16:30 | 90 | Create CI workflow | N/A | GitHub Actions setup |

**Total Time:** [Sum of Duration column] minutes

---

## 📈 Metrics Derived from Time Tracking

### Estimation Accuracy
| Metric | Calculation | Current Value |
|--------|-------------|---------------|
| Avg Estimate vs. Actual | (Estimated Hours - Actual Hours) / Estimated Hours | TBD |
| Estimation Error % | (Actual - Estimated) / Estimated × 100 | TBD |

### Velocity
| Metric | Calculation | Current Value |
|--------|-------------|---------------|
| Stories per Hour | Stories Completed / Total Hours | TBD |
| Points per Hour | Story Points / Total Hours | TBD |

### Capacity
| Metric | Calculation | Current Value |
|--------|-------------|---------------|
| Available Hours/Week | Self-reported capacity | TBD |
| Utilization % | Actual Hours / Available Hours × 100 | TBD |

---

## 🎯 Usage Instructions

### For Each Work Session:
1. **Before starting:** Record the date, start time, and activity
2. **During work:** Focus on the single activity (no multitasking across stories)
3. **After completing:** Record end time and calculate duration
4. **Add notes:** Brief description of what was accomplished

### Weekly:
1. Sum the Duration column for total weekly time
2. Update the "Total Time" row
3. Calculate stories/hour: Stories completed / (Total minutes / 60)

### Per Story:
1. Sum all time entries for that story
2. Compare to initial estimate (if one existed)
3. Calculate estimation accuracy

---

## 📋 Session Types

| Type | Description | Example |
|------|-------------|---------|
| **Implementation** | Writing code to pass contracts | Story 2.7 implementation |
| **Design** | Drafting ADRs, architecture decisions | ADR-0026 drafting |
| **Debugging** | Investigating and fixing issues | Contract failure diagnosis |
| **Review** | AI agent review, code review | Architecture review |
| **Infrastructure** | Environment setup, CI/CD | GitHub Actions setup |
| **Documentation** | Writing docs, updating plans | Management plans |
| **Meeting** | External discussions, planning | Stakeholder review |

## 🔧 Tools Integration

### With Implementation Log
Each Implementation Log entry can reference its corresponding time tracking entry:

```markdown
## 2026-08-01 — Story 2.7 — social-listening-core@abc123

- **Full commit:** `abc1234567890...`
- **Repo:** social-listening-core
- **Story / ADR:** 2.7 / ADR-0026
- **Contract:** contracts/epic-2/story-2.7.gnews-connector.contract.test.ts
- **SKILL.md:** .claude/skills/gnews-connector/SKILL.md
- **Files touched:** src/connectors/gnews/gnewsConnector.ts, ...
- **Full suite at merge:** PASS (113/113)
- **Time spent:** 90 minutes (see time-tracking.md #2026-08-01-0900)
```

### With Git Commits
Use git commit messages to reference time tracking:

```bash
git commit -m "Implement Story 2.7: GNews connector

- Add gnewsConnector.ts and pollGNewsSearch.ts
- Contract-verified against live GNews API
- Time tracked: 90min (time-tracking.md)

Generated by Mistral Vibe.
Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>"
```

| Activity | Time (hours) | % of Total |

| Debugging | [X] | [Y]% |
| Review | [X] | [Y]% |
| Infrastructure | [X] | [Y]% |
| Documentation | [X] | [Y]% |

## Breakdown by Story/ADR

| Story 2.7 | [X]h | [Y]h | [Z]h | GNews connector |
| ADR-0026 | [X]h | [Y]h | [Z]h | Connector decision |

## Lessons Learned

- [Lesson 2]

- [Goal 1]
- [Goal 2]

## ✅ Quick Start

1. **Copy this template** to `docs/time-tracking.md` in your project
2. **Start tracking** from your next session
3. **Review weekly** to identify patterns and improve estimation
4. **Integrate with planning** to set realistic capacity expectations
